title: Polarized superspecial abelian varieties over $\mathbb{F}_p$ via hermitian lattices
summary: We study the set of isomorphism classes of polarized superspecial abelian varieties $(A,λ)$ of a fixed dimension over $\mathbb{F}_p$ with Frobenius endomorphism $π_A=\sqrt{-p}$ and $\ker λ=\ker π_A$. This set plays an important role in the geometry of the supersingular locus, and the generalizations of Deuring's $2T-H$ Theorem by Ibukiyama and Katsura. We determine when this set is nonempty and classify its genera.
